Evaluation Protocol Matrix for Game Intelligence](evaluation_protocol_matrix)

## Future Directions

Future work should connect learned simulators with reliable control, transparent evaluation, and agent training loops that expose failure modes rather than hiding them behind visually convincing rollouts
The most useful synthesis therefore compares how each paper models dynamics, supports control, scales interaction, and exposes limitations
